p.src: 1  Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

en: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

en: 117:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
